name: Bybit API
tagline: Unified V5 REST and WebSocket API for Bybit spot, derivatives, and account data
description: Bybit is a major crypto derivatives exchange offering a Unified Trading Account API (V5) for spot, linear/inverse perpetuals and futures, options, and account management. Developers use REST for market data, trading, and portfolio operations, plus WebSockets for real-time streams. Authentication uses HMAC or RSA API keys with signed requests. Public market endpoints are available without keys; private endpoints require self-serve API keys from the Bybit account.

auth.details: API key + secret via X-BAPI-API-KEY, X-BAPI-SIGN (HMAC-SHA256 or RSA), X-BAPI-TIMESTAMP, X-BAPI-RECV-WINDOW headers; self-serve from account API management

pricing.free_tier_limits: API access included with account; no per-request fee; subject to rate limits by endpoint/IP/UID
pricing.paid_plans: Trading fees apply to orders (maker/taker); no separate API subscription plans published

rate_limits: Per-endpoint IP and UID limits (e.g. market data often 120–600 req/5s; private endpoints lower); see docs rate-limit tables
use_cases: get real-time ticker and order book for a Bybit spot or perpetual symbol
place and cancel spot or linear perpetual orders via unified V5 API
fetch wallet balances and positions under Unified Trading Account
stream live trades and klines over Bybit WebSocket
query funding rates and open interest for perpetual contracts
